description: Verify that TCP in CW / CLOSING / LA / TW ignores a segment with only URG flag set (RFC 793 §3.9 p74). 4 iterations exercise wst ∈ {CW, CLOSING, LA, TW}
approach:
[Objective]
A URG-only segment (no payload, no ACK) is meaningless in late-state connections — RFC 793 §3.9 says drop without response.

[Scenario — chronological]
Four iterations, one per late state. Each: drive DUT to wst, tester sends URG-only segment, DUT must NOT respond.

[Pass condition]
No DUT response in any of the 4 phases.

[Fail condition]
Per phase: prelude failure or Fail_p<n>_unexpected_response.

verdicts.Pass: DUT ignored URG-only in CW/CLOSING/LA/TW — normal
verdicts.Fail_p1_no_handshake_ack: No DUT handshake ACK phase 1 CW
verdicts.Fail_p1_no_close_wait_ack: No DUT close-wait ACK phase 1 CW
verdicts.Fail_p1_unexpected_response: DUT response to URG-only in CW
verdicts.Fail_p2_no_handshake_ack: No DUT handshake ACK phase 2 CLOSING
verdicts.Fail_p2_no_closing_ack: No DUT closing ACK phase 2 CLOSING
verdicts.Fail_p2_unexpected_response: DUT response to URG-only in CLOSING
verdicts.Fail_p3_no_handshake_ack: No DUT handshake ACK phase 3 LA
verdicts.Fail_p3_no_close_wait_ack: No DUT close-wait ACK phase 3 LA
verdicts.Fail_p3_unexpected_response: DUT response to URG-only in LA
verdicts.Fail_p4_no_handshake_ack: No DUT handshake ACK phase 4 TW
verdicts.Fail_p4_no_tester_fin_ack: No DUT tester FIN ACK phase 4 TW
verdicts.Fail_p4_unexpected_response: DUT response to URG-only in TW
